description: Daily Ethereum on-chain metrics: active addresses, transaction count, average gas price

params.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', block_timestamp) AS time, 'eth' AS asset, COUNT(DISTINCT from_address) AS active_addresses, COUNT(*) AS tx_count, AVG(gas_price / 1e9) AS avg_gas_price_gwei, SUM(gas_used * gas_price / 1e18) AS total_fees_eth FROM ethereum.raw.transactions WHERE block_timestamp >= '{start_time}' AND block_timestamp < '{end_time}' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
